section.name: Create reports dynamically, no design tool required
section.p: DynamicJasper is a 100% pure Java library that allows you to create JasperReports without a design tool. Reports are built entirely in code, at runtime: you define columns, groups, styles, charts and crosstabs with a fluent API and DynamicJasper takes care of layout, positioning and report generation.
It's ideal for reports whose structure is data-driven or changes at runtime: the same library code can generate a different report for each user, each request, each data set.
The current version is ${project.version}, built against JasperReports 7.0.8.

ul.li: No design tool: reports are defined in plain Java code — versionable, testable, and fully dynamic.
Automatic layout: columns, bands and elements are laid out automatically; you can also control positions and sizes manually.
Full style control: fonts, sizes, colors, borders, alignment, conditional styles.
Groups: group data by any column, with header/footer bands, subtotals and operations (SUM, COUNT, AVG, MIN, MAX).
Charts: bar, line, pie and other JasperReports chart types with a simple builder.
Crosstabs: pivot tables built at runtime.
Subreports: inline subreports generated dynamically.
Multiple data sources: JDBC, Java beans, XML, JSON and any custom JRDataSource.
Multiple output formats: PDF, Excel, HTML, CSV, RTF, XML, PNG and more via JasperReports exporters.
Multiple expression languages: Java (default), Groovy and JavaScript.
Extensible: custom column types, custom expressions, custom value formatters, custom layout managers.
